title: Thunderhorn Water Well

[[File:Thunderhorn Waterwell.jpg|thumb|Thunderhorn Water Well]]

The '''Thunderhorn Water Well''' is located in the midst of the grasslands in [[Mulgore]],{{co|44|46|Mulgore}} by the north road between [[Thunder Bluff]] and [[Bloodhoof Village]].

This well had been taken over by the [[Venture Company]] in order to control the water supply but were run off by the tauren.
